title: D'Andre Swift Listed as Limited Practice Participant on Thursday
description: Chicago Bears running back D'Andre Swift (groin) was listed as a limited practice participant on Thursday due to a groin injury. Swift was not on Wednesday's injury report, which could indicate that he tweaked the groin during Thursday's practice. The 26-year-old has recorded 447 yards from scrimmage and three touchdowns on 85 total touches through five games so far this season. If he is unable to suit up in Week 7 against the New Orleans Saints, Bears running back Kyle Monangai would likely see a majority of the backfield work. Third-year back Roschon Johnson could factor into the mix as well. Assuming Swift can play on Sunday, he profiles as a solid fantasy RB2 in Week 7.
